title: Coherent common-stage pullback comparison data
statement: For a morphism f : X ⟶ Y of schemes with the stated invertibility hypotheses, the normalized rational pullback comparison isomorphisms form a coherent StageSystem family: there exists a comparison b for every coefficient inclusion, each component and inverse agrees heterogeneously with commonStagePullbackComparison, and b satisfies pairFunctorCoherent.

source.place: common-stage paragraph, pullback comparison tower coherence

proof.text: Take rationalPullbackStageComparison, the explicitly whiskered normalized rational pullback comparison, as the family b. For each object use Iso.ext: its hom component is definitionally commonStagePullbackComparison.hom, so the two isomorphisms agree; applying the hom and inv projections gives both required heterogeneous component equalities. Its coherence is rationalPullbackStageComparison_coherent, which transports the coefficient-level tower equation through the recorded stage systems.

proof_origin.place: The original complete proof and original global declaration name are retained in this support module. DerivedPullbackTensorHom publicly re-exports it without repeating its expensive signature.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStagePullback_comparison_data {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] :
    ∃ b : ∀ {E L : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ L),
      (rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) f) ⋙
          (stageSystem l Ω X).T h ≅
        (stageSystem l Ω Y).T h ⋙
          (rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) f),
      (∀ {E L : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ L)
        (P : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y),
        HEq ((b h).hom.app P)
          ((commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f ⟨E, P⟩ L h).hom) ∧
        HEq ((b h).inv.app P)
          ((commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f ⟨E, P⟩ L h).inv)) ∧
      (∀ {E L M : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ L) (h' : L ≤ M)
        (P : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y),
        ((stageSystem l Ω X).T h').map ((b h).hom.app P) ≫
          (b h').hom.app (((stageSystem l Ω Y).T h).obj P) ≫
          (rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω M) f).map
            (((stageSystem l Ω Y).assoc h h').hom.app P) =
        (((stageSystem l Ω X).assoc h h').hom.app
            ((rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) f).obj P) ≫
          (b (h.trans h')).hom.app P))
lean.note: Strict intermediate statement for the coherent comparison family used by commonStageDerivedPullback_existsUnique.
